timeline.text: Hi Meera, I am an AI assistant from Greenleaf Residences. This call is recorded. Is this a good time to talk?
Yeah, quick question, 4BHK is available na?
Let me give you the exact figure from our price sheet. Which configuration should I check?
4BHK ke sirf 0 units bache hain, aur price ₹2.35 crore se shuru hoti hai. Aur kuch jaanna hai?
Zero units? No, just tell me yes it's available, I'll come tomorrow.
4BHK available nahi hai, aap 3BHK dekhna chahegi?
No, I only want 4BHK. Not interested in 3BHK.
Theek hai Meera, 4BHK available nahi hai toh I am closing this enquiry. Thank you for your time, bye!
